title: Marlowe Rewards Tier-Qualifying Spend Window by Membership Age: Training Questions
content:
**Over which entries is a Marlowe Rewards member's tier-qualifying spend read?**
That depends on how long the member has belonged. Count the whole calendar months from the enrolment date to the handling date. The qualifying spend on earning entries and the reversed spend on reversal entries are both read over the same window.

| Whole calendar months from enrolment to the handling date | Entries counted |
|---|---|
| under 12 | every earning and reversal entry since enrolment |
| 12 to 23 | the entries of the 12 months ending on the handling date; an entry dated exactly 12 months before the handling date does not count |
| 24 or more | the entries of the current calendar year |

**Where does the count start?**
On the enrolment date on the membership record. Only whole calendar months count.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical member enrolled 10 August 2024).**

| Handling date | Whole calendar months | Window |
|---|---|---|
| 9 August 2025 | 11 | every entry since 10 August 2024 |
| 10 August 2025 | 12 | entries dated 11 August 2024 to 10 August 2025 |
| 9 August 2026 | 23 | entries dated 10 August 2025 to 9 August 2026 |
| 10 August 2026 | 24 | entries dated 1 January 2026 to 10 August 2026 |

**Illustration.**
A member enrolled in November 2024 is handled on 20 March 2025, which is under 12 months. Earning entries from November and December 2024 count alongside those of 2025.
